result.instructions: Tools for Document360, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which articles in our help center are still drafts?"; "Search our knowledge base for the refund policy and show the matching articles."; "Draft a new article about password resets in the Getting started category.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Document360 data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run document360_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run document360_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run document360_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. document360_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: document360_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the knowledge base projects this API key can access, with their ids. Start here: most other tools need a project_id. Document360 API: GET /v3/projects.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous reply (cursor paging; it overrides page).

include_total_count.description: true = include total_count in the pagination block.

tools.name: document360_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces of a project. A workspace is one knowledge base inside the project (for example one product or language set). Its id is needed for categories, articles and search. Document360 API: GET /v3/projects/{project_id}/workspaces.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous reply (cursor paging; it overrides page).

include_total_count.description: true = include total_count in the pagination block.

tools.name: document360_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the categories (folders of the table of contents) in one workspace. Document360 API: GET /v3/projects/{project_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}/categories.

lang_code.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. en or fr. Default: the project's primary language.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous reply (cursor paging; it overrides page).

include_total_count.description: true = include total_count in the pagination block.

tools.name: document360_get_category
tools.title: Get a category
tools.description: Get one category: its name, parent, order, status and settings. Document360 API: GET /v3/projects/{project_id}/categories/{category_id}.

tools.name: document360_list_articles
tools.title: List articles
tools.description: List the articles in one workspace: id, title, category, status and version. Document360 API: GET /v3/projects/{project_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}/articles.

lang_code.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. en or fr. Default: the project's primary language.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous reply (cursor paging; it overrides page).

include_total_count.description: true = include total_count in the pagination block.

tools.name: document360_get_article
tools.title: Get an article
tools.description: Get one article: title, raw content (markdown or HTML by content_type), status, version_number and created_by. The latest version is returned, draft or published; set published=true for the live version. Document360 API: GET /v3/projects/{project_id}/articles/{article_id}.

article_id.description: The article id (from document360_list_articles or document360_search_articles).

lang_code.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. en or fr. Default: the project's primary language.

content_mode.description: raw (default): content as stored. display: snippets, variables and glossary terms rendered.

published.description: true = the latest published version; false (default) = the latest version including drafts.

tools.name: document360_search_articles
tools.title: Search articles
tools.description: Search the articles of one workspace by a text query (the knowledge base search, not AI search). Document360 API: GET /v3/projects/{project_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}/search.

query.description: The search text, for example 'refund policy'.

lang_code.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. en or fr. Default: the project's primary language.

tools.name: document360_create_article
tools.title: Create an article
tools.description: Create an article as a DRAFT in a category. Readers do not see it until document360_publish_article runs. Document360 API: POST /v3/projects/{project_id}/articles.

content.description: The article body in the chosen content_type.

content_type.description: markdown (default), wysiwyg or block (Editor 3.0, HTML content).

slug.description: The URL slug of the article.

user_id.description: The author's user id. Read created_by from document360_get_article (the users list is a premium endpoint).

tools.name: document360_update_article
tools.title: Update an article
tools.description: Change an article's title, content, category, order, hidden flag or content_type. Only the fields you send change. With auto_fork (default true), an edit to a published article goes into a new draft, so the live article stays the same until it is published. Document360 API: PATCH /v3/projects/{project_id}/articles/{article_id}.

article_id.description: The article id (from document360_list_articles or document360_search_articles).

lang_code.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. en or fr. Default: the project's primary language.

content.description: The new body in the article's content_type.

category_id.description: Move the article to this category.

hidden.description: true = hide the article from readers.

version_number.description: The version to change (default: the latest version).

auto_fork.description: true (default): edit a published article through a new draft.

user_id.description: The author's user id. Required when auto_fork is true (default) for key-based calls.

tools.name: document360_publish_article
tools.title: Publish an article
tools.description: Publish one draft version of an article, so readers see it. A previously published version is replaced. Get version_number from document360_get_article. Document360 API: POST /v3/projects/{project_id}/articles/{article_id}/publish.

article_id.description: The article id (from document360_list_articles or document360_search_articles).

version_number.description: The draft version number to publish.

user_id.description: The author's user id. Read created_by from document360_get_article (the users list is a premium endpoint).
